title: Spyglass Officially Launched
summary: We are excited to announce the official launch of Spyglass, bringing its powerful capabilities to all users for enhanced insights and productivity.

title: Enhanced File & Image Management
summary: Take full control of your content with a new, intuitive system that allows you to easily manage and customize the display of all your images and files directly within the editor.

title: Introducing Our Public Roadmap
summary: Our new roadmap page provides a clear, continuously updated view of our completed features, current developments, and future innovations.

title: Enhanced Interactive Checkboxes
summary: Experience a significant upgrade to your checkboxes, making them easier to click, drag, and visually align with your modern workspace.

title: Enhanced Editor Collaboration
summary: We've significantly upgraded the editor's collaboration features, making it easier and more intuitive to work with others.

title: Enhanced Collaboration & Shared Content Discovery
summary: Empower seamless teamwork and idea-sharing with improved visibility and effortless discovery of all relevant content from your network.

title: Open Source Noeko
summary: We are open-sourcing Noeko's codebase to give users maximum control, enable direct involvement in project growth, and enhance transparency.

title: Global Language Support
summary: Experience Noeko in your preferred language as we roll out comprehensive international language support, making our platform accessible to a wider global audience.

title: Elevate Your Experience with Fresh Themes
summary: Prepare to customize your workspace like never before with beautifully polished existing themes and a vibrant array of exciting new visual styles.

title: Enhanced Constellation View
summary: Transform your Constellation view into a dynamic exploration tool with powerful new filters and integrated sharing, helping you discover connections and kickstart your work.

title: Advanced Search and Custom Views
summary: Effortlessly find and organize your knowledge with powerful new filters, sorting options, and the ability to save your refined searches for instant access.

title: Dynamic Note Views
summary: Revolutionize your note organization with dynamic display options, allowing you to seamlessly connect and preview information tailored to your thinking.

title: Noeko: Empowering Teams with Self-Hosted & Paid Plans
summary: We're launching Noeko with flexible paid plans and robust self-hosting capabilities, giving your team greater control and scalable enterprise features.

title: Smarter Greetings for Every Moment
summary: We're refining our greetings to perfectly align with your local time, ensuring a consistently accurate and welcoming experience whenever you log in.

title: Enhanced Tag Management
summary: Streamline your workflow by performing quick actions such as unapplying tags, deleting items, and viewing details directly from your tag lists, making content management faster and more intuitive.

title: Expand Your Information Sources
summary: Seamlessly integrate a wider variety of content, including YouTube videos, websites, and text, to centralize all your essential information effortlessly.
